description: This file defines the ScreenPermission entity class for the OrangeHRM system, modeling permissions related to user roles and screens, including access rights such as read, create, update, and delete.

classes.name: ScreenPermission
classes.description: Entity class representing permissions associated with a user role and screen, including access rights flags.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the permission record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the permission record.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read access is permitted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create access is permitted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update access is permitted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete access is permitted.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Associates a UserRole entity with this permission.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Associates a Screen entity with this permission.
